What changes in the representation

Current code already has UUIDs, JSON and individual answer saving. V2 changes the organization and envelopes.

AreaCurrentV2
Survey contentQuestion/rule rows and compiled nodes.Metadata + ordered sections and blocks.
Question structureFamily-specific content and definition.Field: interaction + answerSpec + behaviour.
IdentifiersNode UUID, readable key and sort key.Readable id; field/option uuid; array order.
Answer submissionNode identity and family-shaped value.field_uuid + state + answer_spec + answer_value.

The comparison describes data, not a prescription for storage tables or HTTP routes.

Survey root and document hierarchy

The root includes version metadata. Sections and blocks are ordered arrays.

Survey envelope (arrays abbreviated)

  "title": "Health Screening",
  "projectName": "Health Research",
  "status": "draft",
  "document": {
    "sections": []
  },
  "workflow": {
    "rules": []
  }
}
document
sections[]
blocks[]
Contentheading / paragraph / notice / divider
Inputfield
workflow?.rules[]id / enabled / when / outcome

Root revision describes the survey document; status is draft, published or archived.

A field defines a question

Readable identity, machine identity, interaction and accepted value are separate properties.

Numeric field from the V2 definition

{
  "id": "age",
  "uuid": "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
  "prompt": "How old are you?",
  "interaction": {
    "kind": "number",
    "suffix": "years"
  },
  "answerSpec": {
    "type": "integer",
    "required": true,
    "constraints": {
      "min": 0,
      "max": 120
    }
  }
}

id and uuid

id is the readable name. uuid is the stable identity used by answers and conditions.

interaction and answerSpec

The numeric control describes entry. answerSpec describes integer values, requiredness and numeric limits.

The new field property is answerSpec, replacing response. Separate field.key and option.key are not part of this shape.

Identity and reference names

The definition and the submission deliberately use different property names.

PropertyLocationMeaning
idSurvey / section / block / field / option / ruleReadable identifier.
uuidField or selectable itemStable machine identity. Structural elements need no UUID.
fieldUuidVisibility or workflow conditionReferences the other field by UUID.
field_uuidAnswer envelopeIdentifies the field being answered.
Option UUIDChoice value or choice conditionIdentifies the selected option, independent of its label.

Document order is array position. Machine identity is a UUID, not a position, readable name or typed ULID.

Accepted values and self-description

The same specification appears as answerSpec in a field and answer_spec in an answered submission.

TypeValueTypical constraint
stringTextminLength / maxLength
integer / numberWhole / fractional numbermin / max
boolean / dateBoolean / date stringType-specific restrictions
choice / choice_setOption UUID / array of option UUIDsSelection count for choice_set
object / arrayDefined structured valueCorresponding structure and item rules

A type label alone does not define a structured object. The corresponding specification must describe its contents.

An answered submission

Each answered value includes its expected specification; question text and presentation are not repeated.

Complete numeric answer

{
  "field_uuid": "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
  "client_mutation_id": "60000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
  "state": "answered",
  "answer_spec": {
    "type": "integer",
    "required": true,
    "constraints": {
      "min": 0,
      "max": 120
    }
  },
  "answer_value": 24
}

Envelope

field_uuid identifies the question; client_mutation_id identifies this submission operation; state is answered.

Specification and value

answer_spec carries type and constraints. answer_value carries the actual respondent value.

Interpretation need not load the entire survey. A submitted spec is client-provided data, not proof of published constraints.

Illustrative contract / working proposal07 / 12
FlowForm / Data structurePROPOSED / NOT IMPLEMENTED

Choice answers and structured values

Choice values refer to UUIDs. More complex values use explicitly defined shapes.

Single-choice answer

{
  "field_uuid": "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
  "client_mutation_id": "60000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
  "state": "answered",
  "answer_spec": {
    "type": "choice",
    "required": true
  },
  "answer_value": "20000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
}

Multiple choice

answer_value is an array of option UUIDs, without a selected wrapper.

Other structures

Matching uses a pairs object. Ranking is an ordered option-UUID array. A single-choice matrix maps row UUIDs to column UUIDs.

Structured formats are valid only where the field and its answer_spec define them.

Illustrative contract / working proposal08 / 12
FlowForm / Data structurePROPOSED / NOT IMPLEMENTED

Answered, cleared and complete

No whole-response answer collection is resubmitted for completion.

Cleared answer

{
  "field_uuid": "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
  "client_mutation_id": "60000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006",
  "state": "cleared"
}

Separate completion object

{
  "action": "complete"
}

Different shapes

Answered requires answer_spec and answer_value. Cleared omits answer_value and may omit answer_spec. No saved answer means unanswered.

The answer envelope does not require per-answer revision or committedAt properties from the earlier prototype.

Visibility and workflow data

Field-level display conditions and survey-level outcome rules remain separate.

Conditional visibility example

{
  "visibility": {
    "mode": "conditional",
    "condition": {
      "fieldUuid": "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
      "operator": "equals",
      "value": "20000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
    }
  }
}

Workflow rule from the V2 survey

{
  "id": "underage",
  "enabled": true,
  "when": {
    "fieldUuid": "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    "operator": "less_than",
    "value": 18
  },
  "outcome": "ineligible_underage"
}

An outcome is a result identifier. Rule precedence and automatic termination are not defined by this data alone.
